step1_analysis.description: The extracted netlist consists of passive components forming a Pi-network (L2, R1, C2, C3, C4), which is a standard lumped-element model for an on-chip inductor or transformer winding. It also includes an ideal switch and a separate LC tank, likely representing a sub-block of the distributed active transformer power amplifier described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: Fully Integrated CMOS Power Amplifier Design Using the Distributed Active-Transformer Architecture

Power Added Efficiency (PAE).description: Ratio of RF output power minus RF input power to DC power consumed.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on active PA design, not measurable with the provided passive-only netlist.

Output Power.description: Maximum RF power delivered to the load.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Not measurable with the provided passive netlist.
Typical on-chip inductor values range from 0.1nH to 10nH.

Quality Factor (Q).description: Ratio of imaginary to real part of the impedance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical Q-factor for on-chip inductors in standard CMOS.

Self-Resonance Frequency (SRF).description: Frequency at which the imaginary part of the impedance becomes zero.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by L and parasitic C. Expected to be well above the operating frequency.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the Inductance, Quality Factor, and Self-Resonance Frequency of the extracted passive Pi-network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Extracted Passive Network
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param c_val=100f r_val=10 l_val=1n

* DUT
C1 n0 GND {c_val}
R1 n1 n2 {r_val}
C2 n1 n2 {c_val/10}
C3 n1 GND {c_val/2}
C4 n2 GND {c_val/2}
L1 n0 label_net_0 {l_val}
* Modified switch syntax to include control nodes for ngspice compatibility
S1 n1 GND ctrl GND switch_ideal
L2 n1 n2 {l_val}

.model switch_ideal sw vt=0.5 ron=0.1 roff=1G

* Biasing and Sources
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 dc 0.9
Vctrl ctrl 0 dc 0
Iac n1 0 dc 0 ac 1
Vn2 n2 0 dc 0

.control
ac dec 100 100Meg 100Gig

* Calculate Impedance Z11 (since Iac = 1A, Z11 = V(n1))
let ReZ = real(v(n1))
let ImZ = imag(v(n1))
let Q_factor = ImZ / ReZ
let L_ind = ImZ / (2 * pi * frequency)

* Measure metrics
meas ac max_Q max Q_factor
meas ac SRF when ImZ=0 fall=1
meas ac L_at_1G find L_ind at=1G

print max_Q SRF L_at_1G
quit
.endc
.end
